model.action: Unchanged retained canonical volume scalar plus real massive scalar
model.preparation: chi=epsilon*A*X1, s=sstar, all scalar normal velocities=0, K_ij=0
model.changed_input: All round-reference excitation energy placed in the lowest odd mode; previous equal two-mode occupation was a supplied preparation.

identities.constraint: -8 Delta0 psi+6psi-kappa eps^2 A^2(1-u^2)psi-(6+kappa eps^2 A^2 z u^2)psi^5=0
identities.neck: u=X1=0, reflection-fixed totally geodesic S2 in h=psi^4 H^(-2)gamma
identities.local_development: For an exact nearby smooth constraint solution with the negative sign retained, symmetry and local development imply a strictly future-trapped neck at sufficiently small positive proper time.

levels.momentum_constraint: exactly zero: K_ij=0 and all normal scalar momenta=0
levels.energy_normalization: E=integral T(n,n)dV_h on the initial slice; positive vacuum included separately. Each X1 hemisphere has exactly half by reflection. These are initial regional energies, not received child energies.
levels.units: Retained action units with kappa=1; no SI scale selected.
levels.numerical_scope: Galerkin approximation with independent full residual and resolution comparison; not a certified continuum enclosure.
